profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ LinkedIn | Technical Consulting, Data Engineering, Security, Full-stack Engineering
profile.summary:
As a staff software engineer at LinkedIn, I lead and contribute to various projects that enhance the user experience, security, and accessibility of LinkedIn's Jobs platform. I use my skills in Python, C++, and JavaScript to develop and implement solutions for workflow automation, configuration storage design, A/B testing, and identity authentication. I also mentor and assist my peers as a tech lead, providing technical consulting, unblocking bottlenecks, and enhancing organizational SOPs.

Before joining LinkedIn, I worked for Amazon for seven years, where I led the technical direction for data engineering solutions in Prime Video Security, and developed scoped and secured access solutions for internal AWS accounts for all of Amazon's security teams. I also worked on projects that enabled multi-account switching for Amazon customers, and guided the WeChat login experience for Kindle E-Ink in China. I graduated with a master's degree in electrical and computer engineering from Purdue University in 2014, where I also served as a graduate teaching assistant and received multiple honors and awards.

I am passionate about learning and growing as part of this cutting edge industry, and I value technology, leadership, and communication as my daily life expertise. I am always eager to take on new challenges and collaborate with diverse and talented teams to deliver innovative and impactful solutions.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Spearheaded a unified CRM initiative across three major platforms, successfully delivering a Proof of Concept (POC) for a key Line of Business (LOB) that streamlined cross-functional data integration.
· Architected a ground-up data delivery system using Temporal workflows to integrate NICE IEX with an in-house routing engine. This real-time system monitors and delivers compliance status for over 300 agents, significantly enhancing Workforce Management (WFM) precision.
· Directed the infrastructure and operational launch of a proprietary routing system, scaling the platform across 5 distinct Lines of Business and supporting a user base of 300+ per department.
· Led technical compliance for the Digital Services Act (DSA) regarding Job postings, implementing critical safeguards to mitigate legal risks and protect the organization from potential fines totaling 6% of global revenue.
· Engineered a self-service corporate email verification system for account appeals, achieving a 95% reduction in SLA response times and improving the user recovery experience.
· Executed emergency safety protocols for over 10 million members, effectively neutralizing high-risk account takeover (ATO) threats and securing platform integrity.
· Accelerated international growth by unblocking the Ukrainian language launch, providing localized access to 100% of the target market.
· Cultivated technical excellence as a Tech Lead by mentoring peers, resolving complex architectural bottlenecks, and optimizing organizational Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to boost team velocity.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · JavaScript · Software Infrastructure · Technical Staff Management · Enterprise Software · Couchbase · REST APIs · Full-Stack Development · Java · CSS · SQL

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
· Leading the technical direction for data engineering solutions in Prime Vide Security that is responsible for the entire Prime Video org with over 1M active users.
· Mentoring, developing, and assisting peers under Director of Prime Video Security for technical consulting, unblocking technical bottlenecks, and enhancing organizational SOPs.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
· Developed scoped and secured access solution to internal AWS accounts for all of Amazon's security teams, enabling the teams to do deep integration, monitoring, and budgeting for more than 1M accounts without manual effort.
· Developed Prime Video Security's batch processing data pipeline that is capable of ingesting multi-terra bytes of data with scalability for monitoring the entire Prime Video fleet, detecting any security threat, and discovering fraud and abuse activities within the entire Prime Video organization.
· Developing multiple account switching ability for entire Amazon customers with expected sale growth of 3%.
· Guided and instructed WeChat login experience for Kindle E-Ink in China. This unified the shopping experience in China with all the Amazon login integrated with WeChat option.
· Mentored experienced software development engineer I and interns for improving internal tools with 85% satisfaction and hiring the best.

positions.title: Software development engineer I
positions.description:
· Developing large-scale, multi-threading system for authentication and identity recognition for uni-customer experience with more than 500,000 active users daily.
· Providing multi-client solutions for authentication with 600 more clients including iMDB, Zappos, and Twitch.
· Developed and led database configuration integration with the process reduction of 95% (from several days down to 10 minutes) and has more than 400 active clients to date.
· Developed and led audio-captcha integration on Amazon sign-in page for accessibility and better customer experience with average daily usage of 300 users worldwide.

positions.title: GRADUATE TEACHING ASSISTANT
positions.description:
· Taught in ECE46800 - Introduction To Compilers And Translation Engineering
· Automated scripts to run over 60 students projects and automatically assigned grades using Unix-shell
· Wrote standard compiler for each projects as a reference sample to help students understand course requirements
· Answered and managed students’ questions on Piazza course website
· Created robust, dynamic test cases for each assignments

positions.title: SOFTWARE ENGINEER INTERN
positions.description:
· Worked for Cloud and Virtualization Group
· Constructed a website using Html, CSS, SQL, PHP for internal server rack management
· Wrote test-cases to test different critical conditions for Cisco’s cloud virtualization solution
· Wrote parallel multiple threading disruptions for testing the solution under high pressure

positions.title: GRADUATE TEACHING ASSISTANT
positions.description:
· Taught in CS18000 - Problem Solving & Object-Oriented Programming
· Managed the automated grading system (Web-CAT), assignments, and test suites, and scaled it to serve 200 students
· Taught and programming exercises in areas such as recursion, parallelism, and data structures
· Co-developed projects and labs, ensuring that assignment specifications were precise and conducive to testing
· Created robust, dynamic test cases for most major assignments and conducted laboratory sessions

honors.title: Best Operational Improvement Award
honors.description: Received Best Operational Improvement Award by providing instant viewer for Amazon sign-in pages' customization. This reduces the back and forth talk between teams and provide precision on what customization would look like after implemented instead of text description.

projects.title: COMPILERS AND TRANSLATOR WRITING SYSTEMS
projects.description: · Designed a compiler of LITTLE language, with register allocation and live-ness analysis as optimization strategy, capable to perform recursion, arguments as functions, and variable replacement.

projects.title: DATABASE SYSTEMS
projects.description: · Developed a user interface to access Purdue Computer Science Department’s oracle server along with security protection like low watermark policy and BLP model.
